title: Sync from live does not stop on tables tied by a foreign key, makes no backup for a merge that changes nothing, counts the records a person edits; Sync to live says when nothing was sent and which record is open in a live editor; a deleted copy takes its sync history
steps: S1: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/live-sync-copy-load.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/live-sync-db.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/provision-joomla-check-in.test.mjs (needs a docker daemon for mariadb:11)
expect: S1: 'tables tied by a foreign key, loaded by two streams side by side, load whole: no stream takes a table lock' passes: both tables hold 3000 rows in the scratch copy, no ERROR 1100 in the log.

S1: 'a title the live site changed in a table the copy left alone is one record that came over, not nothing' (records 1), 'a stamp or a counter the live site moved is no record; a category it added is one' (records 1) and 'one title both sites changed is one place kept: the asset that mirrors it follows, never named' (kept is only db:jos_content:["1"]:title) pass.
S1: 'every record the live site had open is checked in on the copy, Joomla 4 and Joomla 3 alike' passes: checked_out NULL (Joomla 4) and 0 (Joomla 3), another prefix untouched.
S2: 'a record open in the live site’s editor is not written, and the answer names whose editor' passes: conflict open-in-editor with lockedBy 'Victor Luu' and lockedSince.
S3: 'a deleted copy takes its sync and push rows with it' and 'a push that wrote nothing ran no sync: no site_sync row' pass.

S4: 'a push that wrote nothing says so — never a success of "0 changes"' passes ([data-push-nothing-sent], group open with 'open by Victor Luu'), and the four 'Sync, up to date' summaries pass (1 record for a table taken whole; small changes; nothing).
fence: webroot-sync.sh ours_try --skip-add-locks; finish_merge took_nothing; live_sync.py records/mirrorColumns; live-push.js recordSync skipped; migration 178
